model: GTW-08 Modbus gateway for Remeha / De Dietrich appliances
applies_to: GTW-08 Modbus RTU gateway on the L-Bus of Remeha / De Dietrich (BDR Thermea) boilers, heat pumps and hybrids, configuration manual 7854678 v.01 (2023-09-15), English section.
summary: The GTW-08 is a small gateway that sits on the appliance's L-Bus and answers Modbus RTU for a BMS. Through it the BMS can read flow, return, flue and outside temperatures, water pressure, status codes and errors, set system power or temperature demands, run heating zones manually, configure cascades and define a fallback demand. This map covers the 16-bit registers of the English section.

addressing.note: The manual's read example sends start register 0x0020 and calls it register 32, so the decimal register numbers in the tables go on the wire unchanged.

source.title: GTW-08 Modbus - Configuration manual (multilingual; English section)
source.pages: English section pp. 4-27: address/baud/parity pp. 4-5, frame example p. 6, data types p. 8, appliance info pp. 9-14, control p. 15, zoning pp. 16-22, cascade pp. 22-25, service and errors pp. 25-26, fallback pp. 26-27

notes: UINT8 and ENUM8 values sit in the low byte of a 16-bit register (data-type table p. 8); they are listed as UINT16 here.

Left out: every UINT32/INT32 register (energy counters 419-451, power 460, zone pump counters 1115/1117, cascade 7151/7160/7162, serial 7228, service starts 516). The manual says 32-bit values take two registers but never says which word comes first.

Also left out because the manual contradicts itself or gives an impossible scale: 272 system power (1 % in one table, 0.01 % in another), 415 (labelled starts but scaled 0.1 µA), 514/515 (resolution printed as '2 hours'), 7166/7167 (UINT8 at 0.1 % over 0-100 %), 7203/7205 (no unit or scale).

Zone registers are listed for zone 1. In the manual's per-zone tables most zone registers step by 512 per zone (641, 1153, 1665 ...), but the activity, mode and pump registers jump after zone 6 (zone 7 1107-type at 5121, not 4179); use the manual's zone tables (pp. 16-21) for zones 2-12.
Cascade member registers 7111-7146 (power output, flow temperature, status, special request per member) are left out: the manual gives their addresses but no data type, scale or coding.

Register 411 main status uses table 16 of the manual; cascade state 7159 and producer status 7209 use table 47, which has the same codes plus 14 (custom load test). Sub status 412 has a long code list in table 17 of the manual.

integration.summary: Set the gateway's rotary address and DIP baud/parity, then read 400/401/409/411 for temperatures, pressure and status. To control, write 258 (algorithm type), 256 power and/or 257 temperature, and 259 heat demand type (7 heating, 8 cooling).
integration.enable: Connect the GTW-08 to the appliance L-Bus. Rotary knob 0-F sets the Modbus address 100-115 (default 100). DIP switches 1-2 set the baud rate (9600 default, 19200, 38400, 57600) and switches 3-4 the parity (none default, odd, even).
integration.watchdog: Registers 21020-21025 define a fallback heat demand (keep, adjust or cancel) used when communication between the gateway and the BMS is lost, with a period in minutes in 21022.
quirks: Reads use function 03; writes use 06 or 16. 8-bit values must still be read and written as whole registers.
Exception code 0x0B means the gateway has not yet read that value from the appliance; retry.
setup: Use the use-case tables (p. 15) to combine 256/257/258/259: e.g. 258 = 0, 256 = 60, 257 = 5000, 259 = 7 heats to 50 °C without exceeding 60 % power.
A zone is put in manual by writing 649 = 1 and a setpoint in 648 or 664.
gotchas: The status LED blinks orange on a Modbus error; fixed red means no Modbus communication.
